formal_results: Exhaustive original-rule shape invariant: a retained comparison surrounding an atomic output can only be seeded, never produced by any of the twelve rules
Exact unary-extension transport packages are uninhabited under the original graph-pointed Seeds, even though their carriers may admit alternative encodings
Generic exact unary elimination fails even under a policy explicitly seeding the raw input atom
A closed front door accepting only an A-to-v directed source word computes original-rule E/reflexivity derivations from the original graph-retaining A seed

The geometric index, selected state, reflexive branch family and all native parameters are computed by fixed factories; no ambient Type, equivalence, prepared state or extension execution is a compiler input
Every primitive compiled step recovers its actual preceding native closure including its derivation, and all leaves have the single original source A as ancestry
Word concatenation agrees on the entire Running record, including package, ancestry derivation and decoder; raw route recovery is exact in the compiled record
Decoded outputs agree with the existing retained transport extension for every word; Boolean observation compatibility and collision refusal transfer to actual original-rule readouts
The BA-parity image factor exists for the original compiler, while constant-summary descent fails on the same two actual runs
No compiled package can be identified with an exact atomic-target unary-extension output

interface.source: Unchanged four graph-retaining Seeds and twelve native rules; compiler ancestry restricted to the A seed, with the existing exact occurrence binding
interface.task: Declared free-incidence path realization and based geometric-state interpretation; its policy is explicit and not uniquely selected by WG
interface.public_front_door: compile(word), for a typed directed word from A; internal Running/execute helpers are not claimed to certify arbitrary supplied decoders
interface.encoding: At each step an E index is State(target), selected by computed path concatenation. Each family branch is the reflexivity package of the actual parent and consumes its derivation.
interface.comparison: Compositional equality of decoded produced states and transferred observation factors, not equality of extension packages or carrier-wide equivalence
interface.ancestry: All leaves descend from pointQ A; dependent E arities may branch and duplicate ancestry, so this is not a single-leaf/unary resource theorem

open_typed_boundaries: Carrier-wide equivalence or full abstraction of the new encoding beyond decoded produced states
Source-mode/anchor and product action comparisons at the new native interface
Source selection of the free-realization policy and observation language
Physical interaction, apparatus-cycle authority, calibration and empirical evidence
